row:
I am a chartered Physiotherapist who is passionate about empowering my clients to maximise their bodies potential. Our bodies are truly amazing and its up to you to look after your own.

My main aim of this channel is to provide short informative videos for my clients to access as and when they are required. 
I hope you enjoy watching them as much as me and my son did making them!
